about: The mutant ledger of internal/sketch/eval, the check-time evaluator (L7). Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./internal/sketch/eval; docs/tooling.md, "Mutant ledger", says when a change must run it. Seeded by unit EV1 (wf10 l7-eval, 2026-11-10).

mutants.name: short-circuit-rhs
mutants.rule: && and || evaluate their right operand only when the left one does not decide (lower/expr.go binary).

mutants.name: int8-constant-widened
mutants.rule: An int8 value wraps at 8 bits: non-constant arithmetic wraps at its type's width (types.md, Basic types 2).

mutants.name: int8-op-widened
mutants.rule: An int8 operation wraps at 8 bits and gives an int8 (types.md, Basic types 2).

mutants.name: defect-caught
mutants.rule: A catch handles typed failures only; a defect is never caught (rows.md, Catch 6).

mutants.name: divide-by-zero-ok
mutants.rule: An integer division by zero is a defect, as Go panics on it.

mutants.name: negative-shift-ok
mutants.rule: A shift by a negative count is a defect, as Go panics on it.

mutants.name: variant-test-true
mutants.from: return r.t.Obj == tt.Obj && r.key == argsKey(tt, t.env)
mutants.rule: A type pattern matches a union value only of that variant (rows.md, Totality; a Go type switch).

mutants.name: returned-error-is-value
mutants.rule: Returning a value of an error type is a failure (types.md, Error types 2).

mutants.name: absent-fact-pure
mutants.to:
if _, ok := fr.info.Footprints[key]; !ok && false {

mutants.rule: An absent footprint is not an empty one (rows.md, Footprints 2): an internal error, never a pure frame.

mutants.name: defect-continues
mutants.rule: A defect stops the run (runtime.md, Tests 3).

mutants.name: incomplete-continues
mutants.rule: The budget is per request: once it runs out, every later obligation is reported not run (L7 plan, section 5).

mutants.name: fuel-ignored
mutants.rule: Every evaluated node costs steps before its work, so a loop that never ends exhausts the budget (L7 plan, section 5).

mutants.name: skip-as-pass
mutants.rule: A skipped law is never a pass (runtime.md, Tests 7; L7 plan, section 5).

mutants.name: reseed-per-case
mutants.rule: Cases advance one binding-local stream; starting a case does not reseed it.

mutants.name: provider-case-reused
mutants.from: v = mustValue(in.call(cf, nil, ctor, nil, vs))
mutants.rule: A pure provider is rebuilt from this case's arguments, not the first case's provider value.

mutants.name: imported-provider-wrong
mutants.rule: The binding's checked conversion selects its method; short names from another package cannot replace it.

mutants.name: generator-fuel-ignored
mutants.from: r.Charge = func(n int64) { mustCharge(in, fr, n) }
mutants.rule: Every generator draw and sized string allocation consumes work before it happens.

mutants.name: slice-write-shared
mutants.rule: A write through one binding never changes another binding's slice or array (Bindings 1).

mutants.name: map-write-shared
mutants.rule: A Map's index write, Put and Delete change only their root (Bindings 1).

mutants.name: append-tip-owned
mutants.rule: An Append that shares its input must not grant exclusive ownership to its output (Bindings 1).

mutants.name: handover-lends-not
mutants.rule: A read that lets a part escape revokes the slot's exclusive ownership (Bindings 1).

mutants.name: record-field-shared
mutants.from: next := &record{t: c.t, key: c.key, fields: append([]Value(nil), c.fields...)}
mutants.rule: A record field write changes that root alone (Bindings 1).

mutants.to: if false && r.root == root && r.view.b == old && samePath(full[:k], r.path) {
mutants.rule: Slice range sees indexed writes through its root (Bindings 3; Loops and len 7); seed-83 bug.

mutants.name: int8-conversion-dropped
mutants.to: if b.Kind == check.Int8 { return int8(0), nil }; out, ok := convertBasic(v, b.Kind)
mutants.rule: Runtime conversion to int8 preserves its low eight bits (Conversions).

mutants.to: vars := map[*check.Var]*slot{}; for k, v := range c.vars { vars[k] = &slot{v: v.v} }; callee := &frame{pkg: c.home.pkg, info: c.home.info, decl: c.home.decl, key: c.key, vars: vars,
mutants.rule: An immediately called literal writes its enclosing mutable locals (Function values 2).

mutants.name: init-order-ignored
mutants.to: for i := len(p.Info.InitOrder)-1; i >= 0; i-- { ini := p.Info.InitOrder[i]
mutants.rule: Every package initializer runs in the checker's dependency order before obligations.

mutants.name: string-range-bytes
mutants.to: for i := range len(dom.(string)) { r := rune(dom.(string)[i])
mutants.rule: String range decodes UTF-8 runes, including invalid bytes, as Go does (Loops and len 1).

mutants.name: copy-fuel-ignored
mutants.from: if ab := in.build(fr, at, int64(s.n)+1, int64(s.n), 0); ab != nil {
mutants.to: if ab := in.build(fr, at, 0, int64(s.n), 0); ab != nil {
mutants.rule: Bulk copying consumes element work before allocation (plan section 5).

mutants.name: recursion-depth-ignored
mutants.rule: The explicit call-depth bound stops recursion with incomplete, never pass.

mutants.name: generic-substitution-unbound
mutants.rule: A generic call's checked arguments bind the callee's type parameters, including nominal patterns (Generics).

mutants.name: machine-done-is-edge
mutants.rule: A step's Done ends the run, so it is no edge of the machine's graph (types.md, Laws 13; lower/machinelaws.go).

mutants.name: machine-initial-unchecked
mutants.rule: A generated run's first state meets a law's target too: a run reaches the state it starts in ($ExploreRuns).

mutants.name: machine-key-negative-zero
mutants.rule: A state key writes a float by its bits: -0 and 0 are two states, since a step can tell them apart (batch-15 X1 M1).

mutants.name: machine-fuel-stop-complete
mutants.from:
out.Status, out.Reason, out.Site = statusOf(ab), ab.msg, in.site(ab.pkg, ab.decl, ab.at)
			out.Evidence = ""
mutants.rule: A search the step budget stops is incomplete, never passed or proved (plan section 5).

mutants.name: machine-replay-unmetered
mutants.rule: Every step call is metered, a replay's too: the explorer rebuilds each state it expands by stepping its run again, so its work exceeds its edges (plan section 5).

mutants.name: machine-runs-ignore-walk
mutants.rule: A generated run over a keyed, listed graph steps by the signal its walk picks among those that change the state, as the test build's run does ($ExploreRuns), so both find the same run.

mutants.name: machine-proof-text-edges
mutants.rule: A whole search's report names the states, edges and depth the test build names for the same law ($ExploreAll).

mutants.name: eval-bytes-unmetered
mutants.rule: Every value allocation is charged to the byte budget before it is made; a run that cannot pay is incomplete.

mutants.name: report-incomplete-as-passed
mutants.rule: An evaluation with an incomplete or not-run obligation never sums up as passed.

mutants.name: eval-stale-source-identity
mutants.rule: The evaluation names the revision of the text it ran on, a package folder's too.

mutants.name: b16d-eval-invariant-searched
mutants.to:
if false && law.Decl.Reach.Pred != nil {
		return skip(
mutants.rule: Check time leaves an always or sometimes law (X2) to ergo test: it has no target variant to search, so searching it is a defect. Its killer is the lowering's suite (it runs ergo check through the CLI the runner builds, which the coverage pass does not instrument): judge it with `go run ./scripts/mutants -run '^b16d-eval-invariant-searched$' ./internal/sketch/eval lower`.

mutants.name: b16d-eval-float-int-wraps
mutants.rule: Check time converts a float to an integer by the lowering's one rule (S-conv: truncate, saturate, NaN to 0), so its verdict agrees with the Go build's.

mutants.name: oracle-o1-skips-effect
mutants.rule: A capability's operation runs on the provider the nearest with binds; check time never skips an effect it can run (plan-tier eval-skips-effect).

mutants.name: oracle-o1-outer-binding-wins
mutants.rule: The provider of a capability is the one the nearest with binds (types.md, Capabilities 2), whatever the outer withs bind (plan-tier eval-provider-nondeterministic).

mutants.name: oracle-o1-with-binding-leaks
mutants.rule: A with's bindings end with its block: after it, the outer provider is bound again (rows.md, With).

mutants.name: oracle-o1-callee-loses-caps
mutants.rule: A function that needs a capability runs with the provider its caller's nearest with binds.

mutants.name: oracle-o1-member-law-unbound
mutants.from: cf.caps = &capEnv{key: typeKey(cf.rt(to)), op: v, next: cf.caps}
mutants.rule: A member law's body runs with its provider bound to its own operation type, so a function it calls that needs the type sees that provider.

mutants.name: oracle-o1-context-law-unbound
mutants.rule: A law under a named context runs with the providers the context builds bound for its body (types.md, Laws 10).

mutants.name: oracle-o1-native-pad-bytes
mutants.rule: strings.PadLeft and PadRight count the runes of s as fmt's %*s does, an invalid byte as one rune.

mutants.name: oracle-o1-native-parse-range
mutants.rule: A number out of its type's range fails strconv.OutOfRange, not Malformed.

mutants.name: oracle-o1-native-times-wraps
mutants.rule: time.Times saturates at the bounds of duration; it never wraps.

mutants.name: oracle-o1-native-intn-modulo
mutants.rule: rand.Seeded's stream is Go's rand.New(rand.NewPCG(seed, "ErgoRand")), draw for draw: IntN is Go's IntN.

mutants.name: oracle-o1-native-splitn-count
mutants.rule: strings.SplitN gives at most n parts, none for n == 0 (an empty slice: Ergo has no nil slice).

mutants.name: oracle-o1-ops-table-dropped
mutants.from: return &operation{value: v, conv: conv, env: fr.env}, nil
mutants.rule: A value converted to an operation type calls its provider's functions through the conversion's checked table (ConvOperations), never by the source value alone.

mutants.name: oracle-o1-named-entry-sees-caller
mutants.rule: A named context's entry sees the providers the context built before it, not the caller's bindings (rows.md, Context 9).

mutants.name: oracle-o1-native-split-empty-sep
mutants.from: pure("strings.Split", func(a []Value) Value { return list(strings.Split(str(a[0]), str(a[1]))) })
mutants.rule: strings.Split with an empty separator splits after each UTF-8 sequence, as Go's does.

mutants.name: oracle-o1-native-ref-update-lost
mutants.rule: A Ref is one cell every copy shares: Update through one copy is seen through every other.

mutants.rule: A with releases its providers in reverse acquisition order, dependents first (resources.md R5, Context ownership 4).

mutants.name: oracle-o2-release-skipped-on-exit
mutants.rule: A with releases what it built on every exit of its block: a return and a typed failure too (Context ownership 3).

mutants.name: oracle-o2-release-in-inner-env
mutants.rule: A release runs in the environment outside the with: a Close that needs a capability takes the outer with's provider, not one its own with binds (Context ownership 6).

mutants.rule: A with releases each provider once (Context ownership 3).

mutants.name: oracle-o2-acquire-fail-leaks
mutants.from: ab = in.releaseAll(fr, at, built, outer, ab)
mutants.rule: A failure while a with builds a provider releases the providers built before it, last first, before it leaves (R7).

mutants.name: oracle-o2-law-case-unreleased
mutants.rule: A law case under a context releases the providers its build acquired when the case ends (types.md, Laws 10).

mutants.name: oracle-o2-context-value-leaks
mutants.rule: A context value's binding ends with its with's block, on every exit (runtime.md G1).

mutants.name: oracle-o2-install-binds-nothing
mutants.from: fr.caps = &capEnv{key: b.key, op: b.op, next: fr.caps}
mutants.rule: A with of a Context value binds the providers the value holds for its block (rows.md, Context values).

mutants.name: oracle-o2-covered-failure-caught

	if ab != nil && ab.kind == ctlFail {

mutants.rule: Under try X catch, a failure covered in a value position inside X passes the catch and leaves the frame (rows.md, Catch 5).

mutants.name: oracle-o3-owned-release-forward
mutants.rule: A frame releases the values it owns last first when it ends (resources.md R5, L8 B1).

mutants.name: oracle-o3-owned-handoff-ignored
mutants.rule: An owned value passed to a parameter that takes it is the callee's to release; the caller releases it no more (resources.md R9).

mutants.name: oracle-o3-native-submono-wraps
mutants.from:
case d < 0 && a > b:
			d = math.MaxInt64
mutants.rule: The duration between two monotonic readings saturates at the largest duration where a - b overflows (runtime/v1 TimeSubMono; time.go, Sub).

mutants.name: oracle-o3-scheduler-host-order
mutants.rule: The scheduler picks the next task by the obligation's schedule seed, not in the order the tasks started (ORACLE O3; runtime.md, Tasks 7).

mutants.name: oracle-o3-virtual-time-skips-wake
mutants.rule: A virtual clock moves to its nearest sleeper's deadline when every task waits, waking the sleepers due then and no later one (stdlib.md, testing.VirtualClock).

mutants.name: oracle-o3-deadlock-passes
mutants.rule: When every task waits and no clock can move, the obligation is a defect that names what each task waits for (ORACLE O3).

mutants.name: oracle-o3-stop-ignored
mutants.rule: Stop ends a sleeping task at its wait: its exit actions run and nothing after the wait does (runtime.md, Tasks 10, I1).

mutants.name: oracle-o4-harness-compares-self
mutants.rule: The agreement harness compares the evaluator's run with the recorded (or built) run, never a run with itself.

mutants.name: oracle-o5-range-follows-other-place
mutants.rule: A for over a slice reached through a field or subscript sees the writes through that place only, not through another place that shared the slice when the loop began (types.md, Bindings 3; Loops and len 7).

mutants.name: oracle-o6-member-unresolved
mutants.rule: A qualified name pkg.X reads the imported package's own let or function (its initializer's value), though the checker records no Uses entry for it.

mutants.name: oracle-o6-func-value-refused
mutants.to:
case *check.Func:
		return nil, fr.unsupported(id, "a function value")
mutants.rule: A declared function named as a value is a value the evaluator calls where it is called.

mutants.name: oracle-o6-instance-unbound
mutants.rule: A generic function's instance as a value carries its type arguments, read in the frame that names it.

mutants.name: oracle-o7-after-dropped
mutants.from:
if fn == nil {
			return optionOf(result, nil, false), nil
mutants.to:
if true {
			return optionOf(result, nil, false), nil
mutants.rule: A machine value's After is its declaration's after function (runtime.md, Machines and actors 10); only a machine with none has no timer in every state.

mutants.name: oracle-o8-borrow-copies
mutants.rule: A write through a borrow writes the place it lends, as the Go target's pointer does (types.md, Borrows).

mutants.name: oracle-o9-yield-goes-on-after-break
mutants.from:
case ctlBreak, ctlReturn, ctlFail, ctlEscape:
			return false, nil
mutants.to:
case ctlBreak, ctlReturn, ctlFail, ctlEscape:
			return true, nil
mutants.rule: A for over a Seq that a function makes: yield returns false once the body ended the loop (a break or a return), as Go's range over a function does (prelude Seq).

mutants.name: oracle-o4-harness-drops-stderr
mutants.rule: The agreement harness compares standard error.

mutants.name: oracle-o4-harness-ignores-exit
mutants.rule: The agreement harness compares the exit status.

mutants.name: oracle-o4-exit-code-ignored
mutants.rule: An os.Exit that leaves main exits with its Code when it is in 1..125 (runtime.md, Exit causes).

mutants.name: oracle-o4-stdin-line-feed-kept
mutants.rule: io.Stdin.Lines gives each line without its line feed.

mutants.name: oracle-o4-console-to-stderr
mutants.rule: The host's Console prints a line on standard output.

mutants.name: oracle-o4-imports-lowering
mutants.rule: The evaluator is the reference every build agrees with: it shares no code with the lowering (ORACLE, import guard).
